name: Tee Shirt Printing
old_description: Looking for a specific item or just browsing for ideas? Logo my Promo is your one-stop shop for promotional products and business gifts. Our extensive range of promo products will ensure you find something to suit your requirements.
about:
Logo my Promo, operating under the name Tee Shirt Printing, is based in Waterbury, Connecticut. The company is led by President Onelia Margiotta. A founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The business supplies promotional merchandise and provides in-house decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, design and printing, and signage production. It also manages e-commerce storefronts and fulfillment for clients. The catalog comprises thousands of items across apparel, drinkware, bags, technology accessories, and awards.

Customers come from sectors such as financial services and banking, as illustrated by a case study for a bank chain needing new-account gifts, and sports and fitness, shown by a horse-show giveaway program. The company serves corporate buyers, event organizers, and marketing departments.

Logo my Promo emphasizes broad product selection, fast delivery, budget-friendly pricing, and customized recommendations as its differentiating factors. The firm was built to simplify branded-merchandise procurement through a single source.
